detail.ja: ADORの公式X（@alldoorsoneroom）が8時48分（KST）に投稿した告知。炎を背景に緑、白、ピンク、水色、黄色のウサギがローラースケートで横切り、最後にADORのロゴが映る12秒のアニメーション映像に、韓国語と英語で「2022年7月22日、ついにADORの新人ガールズグループの初コンテンツが公開されます」と添えた。グループ名やメンバーは明かされず、ハッシュタグもなかった。
detail.en: Posted by ADOR's official X account (@alldoorsoneroom) at 08:48 KST. A 12-second animated clip shows green, white, pink, light-blue and yellow rabbits roller-skating past a backdrop of flames before the ADOR logo appears, with a Korean and English caption: 'FINALLY The first ADOR new girl group will drop its first content on July 22, 2022'. The post named neither the group nor its members and carried no hashtags.

title.ja: ダニエル、「Chinese New Year」表現について謝罪文を投稿
title.en: Danielle posts apology over "Chinese New Year" wording

summary.ja: Phoningで「Chinese New Year」と書いたメッセージが批判を受け、ダニエルが公式Instagramで謝罪文を掲載した。
summary.en: Danielle apologised on the official Instagram after a Phoning message using the phrase 'Chinese New Year' drew criticism.

detail.ja: ダニエルが1月19日にファンアプリPhoningで「what r u bunnies doing for chinese new year?」と送り、「Lunar New Year」と呼ぶべきだとの批判を受けたことへの謝罪文。間違いに気づいてすぐに削除したが既に多くの人に届いてしまったこと、旧正月は韓国を含む多くの国が祝う祝日であり自分の表現は不適切だったとして、深く反省し謝罪すると述べた。
detail.en: Danielle's apology over a Phoning message sent on January 19, 'what r u bunnies doing for chinese new year?', which drew criticism that it should be 'Lunar New Year'. She wrote that she deleted it as soon as she realised her mistake but it had already reached many people, that Lunar New Year is a holiday celebrated by many countries including Korea, and that her wording was inappropriate, for which she deeply apologised.

summary.ja: 「カルグクス」発言と配信中の態度への批判を受け、ミンジがPhoningに「こんにちは、ミンジです」と題した謝罪文を投稿した。
summary.en: After criticism over her 'kalguksu' remark and her manner on a live, Minji posted an apology letter titled 'Hello, this is Minji' on Phoning.

detail.ja: ミンジが1月16日午後、ファンアプリPhoningに「こんにちは、ミンジです」と題して投稿した長文の謝罪文。1月2日のライブ配信での態度と、以前のYouTube出演時の「カルグクスって何ですか」という発言をめぐる批判について、好き嫌いが激しくカルグクスを食べたことがなかったため無意識につぶやいたと説明し、良くない態度に驚き傷ついたBunniesに本当に申し訳ないと謝罪した。
detail.en: A long apology letter titled 'Hello, this is Minji', posted by Minji on the fan app Phoning on the afternoon of January 16. Addressing criticism of her manner in a January 2 live and her earlier 'What is kalguksu?' remark on a YouTube appearance, she explained that she had muttered it unthinkingly because she is a picky eater who had never tried kalguksu, and apologised to Bunnies who were surprised and hurt by the attitude she showed.

Posted at 18:00 KST.
